reason: This plugin is primarily an external-service integration for DeepSeek Harness: it listens to agent/tool/session events, derives file-level AI coding activity metrics, and sends them to WakaTime via its CLI, with rate limiting and batching managed in local state.

summaries.zh: 这是一个 DeepSeek Harness 插件，会自动提取会话中的文件操作行为并上报到 WakaTime，用于记录 AI 辅助开发的心跳、代码行数与时长。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that captures session file activity and reports heartbeat and line-change metrics to WakaTime for tracking AI-assisted coding time and output.

capabilities: Captures file-related agent actions from dsh events and computes per-file line-change metrics
Invokes an external WakaTime CLI process to send heartbeat/metrics reports
Maintains per-project local state for heartbeat rate limiting and batching
Accepts and uses WakaTime API key configuration for authenticated reporting

reasons.code: README describes tracking edit/write/read/str_replace_editor operations and sending AI coding metrics as heartbeats, indicating activity telemetry is transmitted outward to WakaTime.
README requires a WakaTime API key in ~/.wakatime.cfg and documents that data is sent via WakaTime CLI, which creates network and credential-sensitivity concerns.

README and package metadata identify the plugin as a dsh bundle plugin that auto-downloads/uses wakatime-cli and hooks into session/tool events, confirming external-service integration and process invocation.
